# Database schema

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:schema` from apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma and the
     migration SQL. Do not edit by hand: CI regenerates this file and fails on a diff. -->

Supabase Postgres, accessed only by the API through Prisma ORM 7 (`@prisma/adapter-pg`).
All timestamps are `timestamptz` stored in UTC; the database session time zone is pinned
to UTC and Africa/Cairo is applied only when dates are shown or entered. Primary keys
are UUIDv7 unless stated otherwise.

Rules Prisma cannot express — CHECK constraints, triggers (including the append-only
audit log), partial unique indexes and Row Level Security — live in the migration SQL
and are listed under each table. Row Level Security is enabled with **no policies** on
every table, so Supabase’s public Data API (anon / authenticated keys) can read or
write nothing; the API connects as the database owner. Their behaviour is covered by
`apps/api/test/*database*.e2e-spec.ts`.

### users

Prisma model `User`. One login identity. `email` is stored normalized (trimmed, lowercase).

| Column                 | Type               | Null | Key / default         | Notes                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | ------------------ | ---- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                   | Uuid               |      | PK, default `uuid(7)` |                                                                                    |
| `email`                | VarChar(254)       |      | unique                |                                                                                    |
| `role`                 | enum Role          |      |                       |                                                                                    |
| `status`               | enum AccountStatus |      | default `ACTIVE`      |                                                                                    |
| `display_name`         | VarChar(200)       |      |                       |                                                                                    |
| `password_hash`        | String             | yes  |                       | argon2id hash. NULL until the account sets a password (first login by email code). |
| `must_change_password` | Boolean            |      | default `false`       |                                                                                    |
| `password_changed_at`  | Timestamptz(3)     | yes  |                       |                                                                                    |
| `email_verified_at`    | Timestamptz(3)     | yes  |                       |                                                                                    |
| `preferred_locale`     | enum Locale        |      | default `ar`          |                                                                                    |
| `last_login_at`        | Timestamptz(3)     | yes  |                       |                                                                                    |
| `created_by_id`        | Uuid               | yes  |                       |                                                                                    |
| `created_at`           | Timestamptz(3)     |      | default `now()`       |                                                                                    |
| `updated_at`           | Timestamptz(3)     |      | set on update         |                                                                                    |

Foreign keys:

- `createdById` → `users` (on delete: SetNull)

Constraints and rules:

- Index: `role, status`
- Check: `users_display_name_present`
- Check: `users_pending_only_students`
- Trigger: `users_role_change_check`
- Trigger: `users_active_student_linked`
- Row Level Security enabled (no policies)

### student_profiles

Prisma model `StudentProfile`. Authoritative academic record of a student (§4.1). Exists before any account: faculty import or create it; `userId` is set when the student's account is linked (§4.2 Case A, §4.3 first login, or an approved verification request).

| `user_id`          | Uuid           | yes  | unique                |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `seat_number`      | VarChar(20)    |      | unique                | Normalized (trimmed, uppercase, Western digits).                                                                                                             |

| `phone`            | VarChar(20)    | yes  |                       | Self-service field (§4.4): the student may change it directly.                                                                                               |
| `name_key`         | VarChar(200)   |      | default `""`          | Search key derived from `fullName` by a database trigger (spelling variants, diacritics and spacing removed, see `ftms_name_key`). Never written by the app. |

### auth_sessions

Prisma model `AuthSession`. A signed-in device. Refresh tokens rotate on every use; only hashes are stored.

| Column                   | Type            | Null | Key / default         | Notes                                                                           |
| ------------------------ | --------------- | ---- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                     | Uuid            |      | PK, default `uuid(7)` |                                                                                 |
| `user_id`                | Uuid            |      |                       |                                                                                 |
| `method`                 | enum AuthMethod |      |                       |                                                                                 |
| `current_refresh_hash`   | Char(64)        |      |                       | SHA-256 of the current refresh token id.                                        |
| `previous_refresh_hash`  | Char(64)        | yes  |                       | SHA-256 of the previous refresh token id, accepted briefly after a rotation.    |
| `rotated_at`             | Timestamptz(3)  | yes  |                       |                                                                                 |
| `created_at`             | Timestamptz(3)  |      | default `now()`       |                                                                                 |
| `last_used_at`           | Timestamptz(3)  |      | default `now()`       |                                                                                 |
| `expires_at`             | Timestamptz(3)  |      |                       |                                                                                 |
| `revoked_at`             | Timestamptz(3)  | yes  |                       |                                                                                 |
| `revoke_reason`          | VarChar(64)     | yes  |                       |                                                                                 |
| `ip`                     | VarChar(64)     | yes  |                       |                                                                                 |
| `user_agent`             | VarChar(512)    | yes  |                       |                                                                                 |
| `webauthn_credential_id` | Uuid            | yes  |                       | The biometric credential that opened the session; revoking it ends the session. |

Foreign keys:

- `userId` → `users` (on delete: Cascade)

Constraints and rules:

- Index: `userId, revokedAt`
- Index: `webauthnCredentialId`
- Check: `auth_sessions_expiry_after_creation`
- Row Level Security enabled (no policies)

### auth_challenges

Prisma model `AuthChallenge`. Emailed one-time codes (first login, password recovery, signup). Keyed by the email address, because a code can be sent before any account exists (first login of an imported student, §4.3; signup, §4.2). Only an HMAC of the code is stored.

| Column         | Type                  | Null | Key / default         | Notes                                                              |
| -------------- | --------------------- | ---- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`           | Uuid                  |      | PK, default `uuid(7)` |                                                                    |
| `email`        | VarChar(254)          |      |                       | Normalized (lowercase) recipient address.                          |
| `user_id`      | Uuid                  | yes  |                       | The account the code was issued for, when one existed at the time. |
| `purpose`      | enum ChallengePurpose |      |                       |                                                                    |
| `code_hash`    | Char(64)              |      |                       |                                                                    |
| `expires_at`   | Timestamptz(3)        |      |                       |                                                                    |
| `attempts`     | Int                   |      | default `0`           |                                                                    |
| `max_attempts` | Int                   |      |                       |                                                                    |
| `consumed_at`  | Timestamptz(3)        | yes  |                       |                                                                    |
| `created_at`   | Timestamptz(3)        |      | default `now()`       |                                                                    |
| `request_ip`   | VarChar(64)           | yes  |                       |                                                                    |

Foreign keys:

- `userId` → `users` (on delete: Cascade)

Constraints and rules:

- Index: `email, purpose, createdAt`
- Index: `userId`
- Check: `auth_challenges_email_normalized`
- Row Level Security enabled (no policies)

Prisma model `AuditLog`. Append-only record of security-sensitive and administrative actions (§15). UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE are rejected by a database trigger. Actor fields are snapshots, deliberately without foreign keys, so history survives account changes.

| `reason`        | VarChar(500)      | yes  |                               |       |
| `before`        | Json              | yes  |                               |       |
| `after`         | Json              | yes  |                               |       |
| `metadata`      | Json              | yes  |                               |       |
| `ip`            | VarChar(64)       | yes  |                               |       |
| `user_agent`    | VarChar(512)      | yes  |                               |       |

Constraints and rules:

- Index: `occurredAt`

- Index: `resourceType, resourceId`
- Index: `action, occurredAt`
- Trigger: `audit_logs_no_update_delete`

### group_memberships

Prisma model `GroupMembership`. A student's membership in a group over time. At most ONE active membership (`endedAt IS NULL`) per student — enforced by a partial unique index (§5, §16.1). Ended memberships are history and cannot be modified (trigger).

| Column           | Type                  | Null | Key / default         | Notes |
| ---------------- | --------------------- | ---- | --------------------- | ----- |
| `id`             | Uuid                  |      | PK, default `uuid(7)` |       |
| `student_id`     | Uuid                  |      |                       |       |
| `group_id`       | Uuid                  |      |                       |       |
| `source`         | enum MembershipSource |      |                       |       |
| `started_at`     | Timestamptz(3)        |      | default `now()`       |       |
| `ended_at`       | Timestamptz(3)        | yes  |                       |       |
| `assigned_by_id` | Uuid                  | yes  |                       |       |
| `ended_by_id`    | Uuid                  | yes  |                       |       |

Foreign keys:

- `studentId` → `student_profiles` (on delete: Cascade)
- `groupId` → `training_groups` (on delete: Restrict)
- `assignedById` → `users` (on delete: SetNull)
- `endedById` → `users` (on delete: SetNull)

Constraints and rules:

- Index: `groupId, endedAt`
- Index: `studentId, startedAt`
- Partial unique index `group_memberships_one_active_per_student` (where "ended_at" IS NULL)
- Check: `group_memberships_end_after_start`
- Trigger: `group_memberships_check`
- Row Level Security enabled (no policies)

### training_programs

Prisma model `TrainingProgram`. Training program settings (§6.1, §8.1, §11). Exactly one program is current (partial unique index). Defaults (12 weeks, 2 absences, 15/15/60 minutes) are only pre-filled by the settings form — every value here is configurable. Timing values are copied into each visit when it is created (§8.1).

| `duration_weeks`          | Int                    |      |                            |                                                                      |
| `time_zone`               | VarChar(64)            |      | default `"Africa/Cairo"`   | IANA zone of every wall-clock date/time in the program (§16.2).      |

| `grace_minutes`           | Int                    |      |                            |                                                                      |
| `check_in_closes_minutes` | Int                    |      |                            |                                                                      |
| `allowed_absences`        | Int                    |      |                            |                                                                      |
| `biometric_fallback`      | enum BiometricFallback |      | default `ALLOW_UNVERIFIED` | §7.2 fallback for students without an enrolled biometric credential. |
| `geolocation_policy`      | enum GeolocationPolicy |      | default `REQUIRED`         |                                                                      |
| `is_current`              | Boolean                |      | default `true`             |                                                                      |
| `created_by_id`           | Uuid                   | yes  |                            |                                                                      |
| `created_at`              | Timestamptz(3)         |      | default `now()`            |                                                                      |
| `updated_at`              | Timestamptz(3)         |      | set on update              |                                                                      |

Foreign keys:
